INDEPENDENT ACK OF CONTENT AND CURRENT-MAIN APPLICABILITY for exact df717431f52acb401324ba7694b024b07c19d462. This is not landing authority and no candidate or bead exists yet.

The correction is accurate. Commit 0ca09c56809be5bd7109acecf35d8d4171fd9c16 is an ancestor of current main and CostBreakdown.imputedTerms now retains MissingReason, so the old claim that imputation is not derivable was already false. Eligibility is still computed locally in cost and is not carried into CostBreakdown, while the chartless court still records Chart missing despite excluding it from eligibility. Therefore the four-way view remains non-derivable for exactly one reason: Ineligible cannot be distinguished from absent. The revised production Scaladoc and TraceSuite explanation state that boundary without changing the test or public API.

Current-main check: observed main a8d989a68fa8b0626c707456805a0b09eaadf37e; candidate parent 40d2c286bc4df3c074e3fd813be59d297a66cdb2 is the merge base, with one candidate-side commit and eighteen main-side commits. Neither changed path moved on main, and the exact patch applies cleanly with git apply --check. Diff check is clean. Type-discipline surface is clean because this is comment-only: no signature, type, suppressor, constructor, match, error channel, or should-have-changed call site changed.

Unlike 686e227, this gate carries semantically to the observed main. The remaining action is governance: chief-created bead and candidate policy, followed by whatever exact-current-parent receipt the chief requires. No authority is inferred from this acknowledgment.
